scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/frontend_foundation/app.tsx was modified only for the direct route-wiring necessity exception required to expose /provider/viewings; no API or product contract was changed.

No Backend truth repair was required. API authentication, provider ownership scope, invalid transition handling, and optimistic version enforcement remain authoritative in the existing viewing service and router.

The approved local PRV-18 export was used as visual authority. The executable Playwright matrix was used because the in-app browser connector was unavailable with sandbox-state error 'missing field sandboxPolicy'; no external design source was altered.

The current viewing contract provides a list with date/time and status transitions rather than a separate calendar endpoint or display-name projection. The UI therefore uses deterministic date rendering and safe truncated references instead of fabricating calendar records, customer names, or property titles.
knownGaps: Interactive browser-connector verification was unavailable in this environment; executable Playwright visual and accessibility assertions passed for all approved desktop locales.
No Production data or credentials were used, and no real .env file was read.
